description: Rich, cinematic motion graphics and animations. Implement scroll-triggered stagger reveals, parallax layers, magnetic cursor effects, enhanced canvas backgrounds, text split animations, and smooth micro-interactions for high wow-factor.
steps: Enhance js/animations.js scroll reveals: implement stagger animation using IntersectionObserver with incremental delays for child elements (querySelectorAll on .reveal children, add inline style transition-delay based on index * 0.1s), add slide-in-from-left and slide-in-from-right variants with transform: translateX(-60px) initial state

Add parallax scrolling to js/animations.js: create parallax layers for Hero section (.hero-visual moves at 0.5x scroll speed, background shapes at 0.3x), use requestAnimationFrame + window.scrollY to update transform: translateY() on parallax elements

Upgrade js/cursor.js to magnetic cursor: detect hover on interactive elements, calculate distance from cursor to element center, apply smooth transform to element using lerp (linear interpolation) to follow cursor within hover zone, add trailing particle effect (spawn div elements with position: fixed, animate opacity and scale out)

Enhance js/canvas-bg.js particle system: add mouse attraction (particles move toward cursor within radius), implement gradient mesh background using CanvasGradient with animated color stops, add glow effect on particles using shadowBlur and shadowColor

Add text split animation to Hero h1 (.hero-text h1): use JavaScript to split text into <span> per character, apply stagger reveal with scale and opacity animation, implement in js/animations.js as new function splitTextReveal()
Implement scroll progress indicator animation: create circular progress ring around theme toggle or separate element, use stroke-dashoffset animated by scroll percentage, add glow effect on progress
Add smooth page transitions: implement fade overlay on navigation link clicks before scrollIntoView, create transition div with position: fixed covering viewport, animate opacity 0 to 1 and back

Micro-interactions for buttons: add ripple effect on click (create expanding circle div at click coordinates), enhance hover states with transform: scale(1.05) and shadow growth, implement in css/components.css with @keyframes ripple
Project cards: add image parallax on hover (image scales to 110% and translates based on mouse position within card), implement in js/animations.js as new mousemove listener on .project-card elements

Optimize animations for performance: add will-change: transform to animated elements, use transform and opacity only (no layout-triggering properties), implement reduced motion media query to disable complex animations for users with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce
acceptance_criteria: Scroll reveals show stagger effect with elements animating in sequence
Hero section has working parallax with visual moving slower than scroll speed
Cursor exhibits magnetic attraction to buttons and links with smooth easing
Canvas background particles react to mouse movement and show gradient mesh
Hero heading text splits into characters with stagger reveal animation
Scroll progress indicator (circular or linear) updates smoothly with page scroll
Navigation clicks show smooth fade transition overlay before scroll
Buttons show ripple effect on click and enhanced hover scale/shadow
Project card images parallax on hover following mouse position
All animations respect prefers-reduced-motion and use performant properties (transform, opacity)
verification: Open http://localhost/Portofolio_Ilham/ and scroll through all sections
Verify elements reveal with stagger delay (not all at once)
Scroll Hero section and confirm visual moves slower than scroll speed (parallax)
Hover over buttons/links and verify cursor magnetic attraction and trailing effect
Move mouse over canvas and verify particles react and gradient mesh animates
Load page and verify Hero h1 text splits with character-by-character reveal
Scroll page and verify progress indicator updates percentage
Click navigation link and verify fade transition before scroll
Click button and verify ripple effect appears at click position
Hover over project cards and move mouse to verify image parallax follows cursor
Open DevTools Performance tab, record while scrolling, verify no layout thrashing and 60fps maintained
Enable prefers-reduced-motion in browser settings and verify animations simplify
findings:
Successfully implemented all rich cinematic motion graphics features:

1. Scroll Reveals with Stagger Animation: Enhanced IntersectionObserver to apply incremental delays to child elements (skill-chips, service-cards, project-cards, etc.) with smooth fade-up transitions.

2. Parallax Scrolling: Implemented multi-layer parallax on hero-visual (0.5x speed), avatar rings, float badges, and decorative shapes (0.3x-0.6x speeds) using requestAnimationFrame for 60fps performance.

3. Magnetic Cursor: Upgraded cursor.js with magnetic attraction to interactive elements, smooth lerp interpolation, and trailing particle system (max 20 particles with fade-out animations).

4. Enhanced Canvas Background: Added mouse attraction within 180px radius, animated gradient mesh with 3 moving radial gradients, glow effects on particles near cursor, and enhanced connection lines with proximity-based intensity.

5. Text Split Animation: Implemented splitTextReveal() function for Hero h1, splitting .name and .line2 into individual character spans with stagger reveal (0.05s delay per character) and scale transform.

6. Scroll Progress Indicator: Enhanced #scroll-line to show page scroll percentage with smooth width transition and triple-glow shadow effect.

7. Page Transitions: Created smooth fade overlay system for navigation clicks with 200ms fade-in, 300ms hold, 400ms fade-out sequence before scrollIntoView.

8. Button Ripple Effects: Implemented createRipple() function with dynamic sizing, click-position calculation, and CSS @keyframes ripple animation on all primary, secondary, and contact buttons.

9. Project Card Image Parallax: Added mousemove listener to scale images to 110% and translate based on cursor position within card bounds (±15px range).

10. Performance Optimization: Added will-change: transform to all animated elements, used only transform and opacity (no layout-triggering properties), implemented requestAnimationFrame for smooth animations.

11. Reduced Motion Support: Comprehensive @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) query disables all complex animations, sets duration to 0.01ms, hides cursor effects, and removes transforms.

12. Additional Micro-interactions: Navbar auto-hide on scroll down, enhanced hover states with cubic-bezier easing, form input shake on validation error, timeline card stagger reveals, section-aware navigation highlighting, and parallax mouse movement on hero float badges.

All files created:
- js/animations.js (enhanced with parallax, split text, scroll progress)
- js/cursor.js (magnetic effect + particle trail system)
- js/canvas-bg.js (mouse attraction + gradient mesh)
- js/micro-interactions.js (ripple effects + additional UX enhancements)
- css/motion-graphics.css (performance optimizations + reduced motion support)

Integrated into index.html. Ready for manual browser testing.
